record.field: Every fixed-term labour contract with this employer counts, also the ones signed before this system: type their number on the person. A trial (probation) agreement does not count.

Labour Code 2019, article 20: a fixed-term contract runs at most 36 months; when it ends, one more fixed-term contract may be signed, and after that the contract should be permanent. There are exceptions (older workers, foreign workers, some union officials and state-enterprise managers). To confirm with an adviser.
Every time-based fixed-term contract (PKWT) with this employer counts, extensions included, also the ones signed before this system: type their number and months on the person.
Government Regulation 35/2021, article 8: a time-based fixed-term contract (PKWT), extensions included, runs at most 5 years in total. To confirm with an adviser.
